This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners as well as the learned counsel for the Informant-Opposite Party No.2 who appears before this Court today by filing a newly executed vakalatnama and learned counsel for the State.
Perused the application as well as the prayer made therein.

3. By filing the present application under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. the husband and in-laws, who are the Petitioners before this Court, have prayed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding in G.R. Case No.77 of 2022 which corresponds to Derabish P.S. Case No.8 dated 15.01.2022 which was registered at the instance of the Opposite Party No.2 for commission of an offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of I.P.C. read with Section 4 of D.P. Act.

4. Learned counsel for the Petitioners at the outset referring to the order passed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court dated 14.07.2025 in TRP(C) No.111 of 2024 at Annexure-3 stated before this Court that the matter has been amicably settled and that the parties have decided to withdraw the respective cases.
Such fact was brought to the notice of the learned Coordinate Bench by filing a joint affidavit.
The learned Coordinate Bench while disposing of the matter vide order dated 14.07.2025 has taken note of the aforesaid development.
Moreover, in Para-4 of the order dated ) Bipin Bihari Nath vs ) State Of Odisha .....

the learned Coordinate Bench has granted liberty to the Parties to move the respective court for withdrawal of the present proceeding.

In view of the aforesaid settlement, the Petitioners have prayed for quashing of the entire proceeding on the ground that the further continuance of such proceeding would be an abuse of process of law.

5. Learned counsel for the Opposite Party No.2-Informant on the other hand, while supporting the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioners, stated before this Court that she does not want to proceed further in this case as the matter has been amicably settled and she has been paid her dues.
She further contended that she will have no objection in the event the entire criminal proceeding is quashed.

6. Learned counsel for the State on the other hand contended that in view of the order dated 14.07.2025 recording the settlement between the parties on compromise with reference to the joint affidavit filed by the Parties before the learned Coordinate Bench, he will have no objection in the event this Court passes any appropriate order securing the ends of justice.

7. Having heard the learned counsels for the respective parties, on a careful examination of the background facts, further taking note of the dispute as well as the settlement arrived at between he parties, which has been reflected vide order dated 14.07.2025 of the learned Coordinate Bench in TRP(C) No.111 of 2024, this Court is of the view that the matter has been amicably settled and compromised and that the Opposite Party No.2 has accepted the permanent alimony.

Moreover,
taking into consideration the stands of the Opposite party No.2 that she does not want to proceed further in the present criminal case, this Court is of the view that permitting the present criminal proceeding to continue further would amount to abuse of process of law and the same would unnecessarily cause wastage of valuable time of the Court.

Accordingly, this Court is of the view that the present case is a fit case where this Court can exercise its inherent powers under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. to curtail the present criminal proceeding.
As such the entire criminal proceeding against the Petitioners in G.R. Case No.77 of 2022 arising out of Derabish P.S. Case No.8 dated 15.01.2022 is hereby quashed.
8. Accordingly, the CRLMC application stands allowed.
( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge Rubi ) Bipin Bihari Nath vs ) State Of Odisha .....
